profile.headline: Robotics | SLAM | Perception | Controls | Builder
profile.summary: Seeking developer opportunities in the LA area. If you’re in need of a results oriented computer engineer, lets connect!

positions.title: Sr. Autonomy Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fountainhead-Orchard Hills, Maryland, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Developing software for use in autonomous vehicles. Helped develop tools for a wide-range of fields such as drivers for accurate state estimation, scripts for software deployments, and algorithm tuning for multiple sensors. Most work was done using ROS2.

Led the search and validation of multiple open source SLAM solutions for use in a large 120mx150m factory environment. These included Google Cartographer, SLAM Toolbox, MOLA Slam, and OpenVLSLAM. After validating, made the call to go with Kitware SLAM after verifying 1 centimeter accuracy and <2% map distortion. 

Created and deployed custom Ubuntu images for use in a fleet of AMR’s using mkosi. Worked closely with systemd, bash, and C++ to make sure sensor drivers, update scripts, and the AMR software was ready for use in production. 

Developed and implemented a ROS2 action server for the JLG scissor demo exhibited in CES 2026. The action server handled commands from the camera perception system and the demo's fleet control system to place and retract a beam that was welded.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Helped design and develop the Manufacturing Execution System implemented at the McConnellsburg facility on May 29, 2023.

Developed a full stack application using C++, Microsoft SQL, and the UDP transmission protocol to monitor the current status of Motocom frame welding robots. Created a dashboard using Bootstrap (Ignition) to display the results live. Used Github as well as Github actions for source control and automated deployments for application releases.

Developed an OEE dashboard to track takt and cycle times on the Jerrdan standard carrier line. Stored downtime entries in a Microsoft SQL database.

Managed different networks and developed applications that communicate through different VLAN's and network environments(Internal,Plant Shared Services Zone, and Demilitarized Zone).

positions.title: Chief Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Software Architect for the development of a sports entertainment multiplayer game. 
Used AI to design and implement the applications entire backend and database.
Implemented Python Flask APIs for the core functionality, and hosted them using Google Cloud Run services.
Created a SQLess database schema and implemented it using Firebase's Cloud Firestore Database.
Implemented game functionality using Google Cloud Run's container registry and their task services.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Software Architectural Design · Python (Programming Language) · Cloud Firestore · Google Cloud Run · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Docker

positions.title: Health and well-being
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
positions.description: Currently taking a break to continue pursuing my interests as well as finding a mental balance following the chaotic events of the COVID-19 pandemic.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutored for the Computer Science department at UCSD. This entailed helping students understand coding concepts as well as helping them debug their projects. Worked with a team to supervise and grade students work. Tutoring involved data structures, software engineering, Linux, scripts, and operating systems.

company.name: UC San Diego Computer Science and Engineering Department (CSE)

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Designed and implemented system requirements involving security systems deployed by the company in different fields. Implemented a password manager in Java that created unique passwords using SHA-256. The passwords were then stored in a MySQL database using JDBC drivers.

positions.title: Thermal Engineer
positions.description: Worked in storing and cataloguing heaters and other thermal designs using a hash table and different data structures in C++.

projects.title: Go Monte-Carlo AI player
projects.description: Developed an AI opponent for a simplified version of the game Go that uses Monte-Carlo tree search with minimax policy.
